newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilt prices slightly up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilt prices slightly up in light trade.

text.p: * Indian government security prices marginally up in light noon trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
* Buying interest in latest auctioned stock, 12.69 percent 2002 peters out, prices down to 100.17 rupees from Tuesday's 100.23 they said.
* Trade seen picking up in the next days as call money eases. Call money down to 7.0 percent in latest deals Wednesday against Tuesday's close of 8.0-8.25 percent.
* In latest deals, the 12.69 percent 2002 traded at 100.12 against Tuesday's 100.23, the 13.40 percent 1999 rises to 104.55 from 104.50 and the 13.85 percent 2001 up at 104.90 from 104.85.
* Treasury bill maturing in December 1997 traded at a yield of 9.12 percent against Tuesday's 9.20 percent.
